_note: Metadata for each knowledge-base document (problem statement section 5: source, jurisdiction, effective date, version, applicability). The documents are paraphrased principles written for this project, not verbatim law: 'version' and 'effective_date' describe this KB entry (git history), not the underlying regulation. 'applies_to' lists the domain tags from app/rag/kb_metadata.py DOMAIN_TAGS, or 'any'. 'generic_baseline' marks domain-agnostic documents that may be cited but never count as domain coverage. ingest.py only reads *.txt, so this file is not embedded.

data_protection.title: Data Protection and Privacy Principles
data_protection.source: Curated paraphrase of principles common to India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act and comparable data-protection frameworks
data_protection.jurisdiction: India; principles common to comparable frameworks elsewhere

fair_lending.title: Fair Lending and Responsible Credit Assessment Principles
fair_lending.source: Curated paraphrase of fair-practice and responsible-lending principles, including India's fair practices guidance for banks and NBFCs
fair_lending.jurisdiction: India; principles common to most jurisdictions

general_security_baseline.title: General Security and Privacy Baseline (Domain-Agnostic)
general_security_baseline.source: Curated summary of widely used security practice, independent of any specific regulatory framework

healthcare_privacy.title: Healthcare Data Privacy Principles
healthcare_privacy.source: Curated paraphrase of health-data privacy principles such as HIPAA (US) and health-data provisions of broader data-protection laws

kyc_aml.title: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Principles
kyc_aml.source: Curated paraphrase of KYC and AML principles for institutions offering account opening, lending or payment services, including India's regulatory environment for banks and NBFCs
kyc_aml.jurisdiction: India; principles common to most jurisdictions

payment_security.title: Payment and Cardholder Data Security Principles
payment_security.source: Curated paraphrase of industry payment-card security practice
